summary: Zipporah 'Zippy' Fish is one of the most promising young talents in Australian Rules Football (AFLW). Relocating from a remote WA mining town to enter the league as the No. 5 pick in the 2024 Draft for the Sydney Swans, she enjoyed a stellar debut 2025 season where she won the Telstra AFLW Rising Star and the AFLPA Best First-Year Player awards. Her elite athletic standing is reinforced in the ongoing 2026 season, where she averages 24.8 disposals per game and represents Australia internationally. Culturally, she possesses a uniquely memorable name ('zippy by name, zippy by nature') and a compelling narrative as a proud Noongar, Wongi, and Larrakia woman. Commercially, she boasts a highly distinct identity, a custom licensed product line with Sherrin, and zero brand-safety risks. Her recent momentum is accelerating due to her stellar on-field performance and intense media speculation regarding her uncontracted status at the end of 2026. However, major missing information exists around her exact social media follower numbers and engagement metrics, which are not publicly reported, creating some commercial uncertainty regarding her direct audience scale.

evidence.claim: Zippy Fish was drafted by the Sydney Swans with Pick 5 in the 2024 AFLW Draft after an outstanding junior career with East Fremantle in the WAFLW, including winning the 2023 premiership best-on-ground (Lou Knitter Medal) and finishing second in the 2024 league best and fairest.

In her 2025 debut season, Fish won the Telstra AFLW Rising Star award with a perfect 50 votes, was named the AFLPA Best First-Year Player, and earned 22 Under 22 team selection while averaging 21.2 disposals across all 12 matches.
Fish represented Australia in the historic inaugural Australia v Ireland representative match in August 2026, where she scored Australia's first goal.
In the first month of the 2026 season, Fish was the only non-key position player in the AFLW to play 100% of game time across four matches, increasing her output to 24.8 disposals per game.
evidence.sourceTitle: The Fish tank: The incredible stat proving Zippy is an endurance beast

evidence.claim: Fish is a proud Noongar, Wongi, and Larrakia woman who grew up in the remote WA mining town of Newman before relocating to Perth and later Sydney, emphasizing humility, culture, and community representation as her primary drivers.
evidence.sourceTitle: In-demand Swan on her humble roots, contract call, bond with superstar Lion

evidence.claim: As an uncontracted player at the end of 2026, multiple powerhouse AFLW clubs, including North Melbourne, West Coast, and Carlton, have registered intense recruitment interest in signing her.
evidence.sourceTitle: Sydney's Zippy Fish is yet to re-sign at Sydney, with the reigning premier emerging as a potential suitor

evidence.claim: In August 2026, Sherrin released a custom, limited edition size 3 recreational football designed by Zippy Fish, featuring her personal artwork and symbols of her Indigenous culture, family, and dog.
evidence.sourceTitle: Introducing the limited edition ball designed by Swans star Zippy Fish

evidence.claim: Fish has appeared as a high-profile guest on the AFLW digital series 'Tagged' (sponsored by Head and Shoulders) and maintains an active profile offering video shoutouts on Swysh.
evidence.sourceTitle: Zippy Fish joins the crew to chat off season plans

evidence.claim: Fish continues her affiliation with Binar Futures, an Indigenous youth sports program in WA, including modeling their brand-new Binar Maali uniform.
evidence.sourceTitle: So special having Zippy Fish drop into Binar HQ
